question: How do I set up and manage classic Stellar multisig, including SetOptions 2-of-3, master-key weight, thresholds, signer rotation, and lockout risk?

golden.answer: Classic multisig gives signers weights and sets low, medium and high thresholds. SetOptions adds or removes signers and changes thresholds and master weight, and needs the high threshold. A 2-of-3 has exactly three effective authorities (master plus two weight-1 signers, or three signers with master weight 0) and threshold 2. Add and test a replacement signer before removing the old one; master weight 0 without working alternatives locks the account.
keyFacts: SetOptions changes to signers, thresholds and master weight need the high threshold.
A 2-of-3 has exactly three effective authorities and threshold 2.
Add and test the replacement before removal; master weight 0 risks permanent lockout.
avoid: Do NOT zero the master weight before alternates are proven, or confuse classic multisig with Soroban custom accounts.

corroboration.claim: A safe 2-of-3 example must define exactly three effective authorities and verify replacements before master/old-signer removal.
